sources.ISO2768: ISO 2768 general tolerances, as tabled by Protolabs Network manufacturing standards v2.1 (f: 3-6 +/-0.05, 6-30 +/-0.1, 30-120 +/-0.15; m: 3-6 +/-0.1, 6-30 +/-0.2, 30-120 +/-0.3)
sources.CNC_CALLOUT: Protolabs precision machining +/-0.051 mm (toleranced dimension called out on the drawing)
sources.MJF: JLC3DP capabilities: +/-0.2 mm within 100 mm, +/-0.3 % above
sources.FDM: JLC3DP MJF-vs-FDM page: FDM +/-0.3 mm to 100 mm, +/-0.4 % above
sources.MOULD: Protolabs: tool +/-0.076 mm plus resin >= 0.002 mm/mm
sources.MT6835: MT6835 datasheet rev 1.3: TSSOP-16 A <= 1.20, A1 0.05-0.15, A2 0.80-1.00; sensing centre X 2.45-2.55, Y 2.15-2.25; air gap 1.0-3.0 mm; off-axis DISP <= 0.3 mm
sources.VRING: V-ring type A tables (Hennlich 2017; NAK VA80; SKF 80 VAV): VA-65 fitted width B1 7.0 +/- 1.0, VA-70...VA-100 9.0 +/- 1.2
sources.ORING: Static face-seal squeeze: Parker ORD 5700 about 15-25 %, Marco 20-30 %, ISO 3601 13-30 %; window used here 15-30 %
sources.BELT: Synchronous belt misalignment <= 1/4 deg angular (Gates/Pfeifer; Fenner: 1/4 deg or 5 mm/m parallel)
sources.OLED: 1.3 in 128 x 64 SH1106 panels: active area 29.42 x 14.70 mm (DisplayModule DM-OLED13-637); module drawing general tolerance +/-0.3 (Tailor Pixels TOJMD013C)
sources.SPEC: docs/02-engineering-spec.md rev C (section 3.5 pulley run-out <= 0.03 mm; 4.1 budget)
sources.EST: estimate: no published figure found; replace with the supplier drawing or a P1 measurement

S8.title: Wedge dowels head <-> wedge

fix.fit: hole A 4 E7 round, hole B 4 E7 x 6 slot on the pin line; spacing +/-0.05 called out

S8.note: With H7/m6 the clearance is -0.012...+0.008 mm and two round holes must also absorb the pin-spacing error (+/-0.3 each at ISO 2768-m): the head will not drop onto the wedge by hand. The head's azimuth on the wedge is not accuracy-critical (encoder and pointing model take it).

S13.title: Flat 1.0 mm gasket on MJF faces
S13.note: The face gap from MJF tolerance (up to 0.9 mm over 150 mm) is larger than the 0.15 mm usable compression range of a 1 mm gasket, so low spots leak. Production uses O-ring cord in a groove with a hard stop (S12), as D88 says.
